card.name: Small words in historical narrative text
card.fires_on: Short linking words (the, of, for, in, from, near, chief) in general web prose about history, law or business, just before a proper name or formal noun phrase.

modes.label: Article before a title
modes.description: The word The at the start of a film or work title in a history passage.
modes.example: film,<< The>> Birth of a Nation (191

modes.label: Preposition in a narrative
modes.description: A preposition after a verb or noun, such as for, in, of or from, in a historical or legal account.
modes.example: engaging in any course<< of>> business or doing any act for the purpose

modes.label: Title word before a role
modes.description: A role word like chief before a position name in a biography.
modes.example: appointed by President Taylor as<< chief>> justice of Minnesota

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect, apart from some push away from assessment words.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in history and legal passages, right before a name or formal term.
